detach_file.description: Unloads a file body from context without deleting its source.
rules: Use the same folder-rooted path as ATTACH_FILE (for example jin_core/src/main.py). The attached folder ID is not a path prefix. With one attached folder, legacy plain relative and ID-prefixed paths remain accepted. Without #Lstart-Lend, every loaded FILE_CONTENT block for that file is detached; with a line range, only the block loaded for that exact requested range is detached.

Detaching removes only the FILE_CONTENT body. The original tool/action result remains and shows Status: detached at <timestamp>; the source file is not deleted. Detaching a folder unloads its loaded files.
